findings.label: Property-based class is a deterministic corpus
findings.detail: Hypothesis is not a repo dependency and was correctly not added; the malformed-MIME class is a parametrized corpus exhaustive over the parser's typed IncompleteReason modes. Honestly disclosed in the test module and evidence file. If randomized property testing is wanted later it is a scoped follow-up, not a gate blocker.

findings.label: PROMPT_INJECTION axis asymmetry asserted, not changed
findings.detail: Standalone PROMPT_INJECTION yields disposition REVIEW but leaves threat_likelihood NOT_EVALUATED because the category is intentionally outside _DECEPTION_CATEGORIES in the unchanged policy. The harness locks this in as the current safe contract and documents that surfacing it on the threat axis would be a reviewed policy change. Correct call for a tests-only task; carry forward as a conscious policy question for a later phase.

findings.label: Deferred threats explicitly out of scope
findings.detail: T-08, T-09, T-13, T-19/T-20, T-21, T-22, T-27 are listed as deferred to Phases 2-6. Correct per the phase gating (Phase 1 performs no model/remote inference, no feeds, no training). Recorded so the G1 gate review does not mistake deferral for a gap.
